# proofmarks

> Proofmarks renders culturally specific proofreading notation over real, selectable browser text from plain correction data.

Primary documentation:
- Full agent context: /llms-full.txt
- Offline package guide: node_modules/proofmarks/AGENT_GUIDE.md (ships with the npm package)
- Site docs: /docs and /get-started

Secondary references (repository):
- Agent guide: https://github.com/cguodesign/proofmarks/blob/main/docs/agent-guide.md
- Public API: https://github.com/cguodesign/proofmarks/blob/main/docs/public-api-v1.md
- Five-minute quickstart: https://github.com/cguodesign/proofmarks/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md
- Support matrix: https://github.com/cguodesign/proofmarks/blob/main/docs/support-matrix.md

Agent contract:
- Install `proofmarks`; use `proofmarks/react` or the vanilla root entry and one notation pack. `proofmarks/styles.css` is optional (default CSS variable values only).
- The eight operations are delete, insert, replace, transpose, move, increase-spacing, decrease-spacing, and cancel-correction.
- Offsets are UTF-16 code units over `getSourceText(root)`. Before mounting it equals the root's `textContent`; after mounting, raw `textContent` also includes SVG labels.
- `decrease-spacing` targets existing whitespace only.
- Correction JSON is notation-neutral; never encode proof symbols or geometry.
- Do not guess between jis, gb, cns3927, ks, and enUS. Ask when the convention is unspecified, or expose a picker so end users choose.
- Reserve room: `padding: 44px 20px` and `line-height: 1.8` on the root; start with 3–6 word-level corrections across 2–4 lines. Handle `insufficient-room` (its `collisions` field says what overlaps).
- Handle `onIssue`; never fabricate unsupported notation. React reports `invalid-corrections`; vanilla create/update throw. Stale marks are cleared when the text changed. Right-to-left text reports `unverified-direction`.
- The renderer draws supplied data. Optional `proofmarks/helpers` (findRange, offsetsFromSelection, getSourceText, correctionsFromDiff, applyCorrections) help the app author it; `applyCorrections` throws on conflicting corrections.
- Treat `showProofmarks`, `appearance`, and the constrained `markStyle` fields as presentation only. Editorial motion uses Web Animations; set `animate: false` before capture only for exporters that copy computed styles.
- Preserve native selectable, copyable, accessible text.
